name: Precipice
summary: Precipice is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies directional momentum and enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It uses a combination of technical indicators to confirm trend strength before opening positions and applies trailing stops to protect profits. The EA aims to capture medium-to-long-term trend moves while managing risk through position sizing and stop losses.
summary_zh: Precipice是一个趋势跟踪型EA，通过识别方向性动量并沿当前趋势方向入场交易。它结合多个技术指标确认趋势强度后再开仓，并使用移动止损保护利润。该EA旨在捕捉中长线趋势行情，同时通过仓位管理和止损来控制风险。
strategy_analysis: Precipice策略的核心概念是基于趋势跟踪，通过技术指标判断市场的主趋势方向并在趋势确认后入场。入场条件通常依赖移动平均线的排列方向或价格突破关键水平来确认趋势成立，配合动量指标如RSI或MACD来过滤假信号。出场条件包括预设的止损和止盈水平，以及移动止损机制在趋势延续时锁定利润。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理上，EA设置了最大持仓限制和单笔风险控制，但具体参数取决于用户的配置。整体策略偏向中长线持仓，适合趋势明确的市场环境，在震荡市中可能产生连续止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the Precipice strategy is trend following, using technical indicators to determine the prevailing market trend direction and entering trades after trend confirmation. Entry conditions typically rely on moving average alignment or price breaking through key levels to confirm trend establishment, combined with momentum indicators such as RSI or MACD to filter out false signals. Exit conditions include preset stop loss and take profit levels, as well as a trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits as the trend extends. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, with some versions potentially including dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and per-trade risk controls, though specific parameters depend on user configuration. The overall strategy leans toward medium-to-long-term holding periods, performing best in clearly trending markets, while it may suffer consecutive stop losses during choppy or range-bound conditions.

pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，在趋势行情中表现良好
使用移动止损机制保护浮盈，有助于提高盈利因子
参数化设计允许用户根据不同品种和市场调整策略
入场有指标过滤条件，减少假信号带来的亏损
支持止损和止盈设置，具备基本的风控框架
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic that performs well in trending markets
Trailing stop mechanism protects floating profits, helping improve profit factor
Parameterized design allows users to adjust strategy for different instruments and markets
Entry filtered by technical indicators, reducing losses from false signals
Supports stop loss and take profit settings with a basic risk management framework
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生连续止损，回撤可能较大
缺乏市场状态识别机制，无法自动切换趋势和震荡模式
固定参数可能在不同市场周期下表现差异较大
未包含资金管理模块如风险百分比计算，仓位管理较为简单
缺少扩展的时间过滤和新闻事件过滤功能
cons_en: Trend-following strategy prone to consecutive stop losses in range-bound markets with potentially large drawdowns
Lacks market regime detection to automatically switch between trend and range modes
Fixed parameters may perform very differently across market cycles
No money management module such as risk percentage calculation, position sizing is relatively basic
Missing time filters and news event filters for enhanced trade filtering
improvements: 增加市场状态识别模块，在震荡行情中暂停交易或切换策略模式
引入基于账户风险百分比的动态仓位计算，替代固定手数方式
添加交易时间过滤和重大新闻事件过滤，避免不利时段开仓
improvements_en: Add market regime detection module to pause trading or switch strategy mode during range-bound conditions
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage instead of fixed lot size
Add trading session filters and major news event filters to avoid opening positions during unfavorable periods

risk_points: 趋势策略在震荡市中可能连续止损导致较大回撤
固定手数缺乏根据账户资金动态调整的风控能力
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线上重复开仓
risk_points_en: Trend strategy may incur consecutive stop losses leading to significant drawdown in range-bound markets
Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic adjustment capability based on account equity
Missing new bar check mechanism may lead to repeated entries on the same bar
